title: Two men in El Paso say they are escaped descendants of humans taken off Earth as slaves

tellings.quote: when the ETSs left the earth they took humans with him as slaves.

plain: Two men in El Paso, Texas, are said to have claimed that they descend from humans taken off Earth as slaves, and that they had escaped back. Lyn Buchanan, a former Army sergeant, tells Michels this as he heard it from the researcher Linda Moulton Howe. In the story, "when the ETs left the earth they took humans with him as slaves," ETs meaning extraterrestrials.
